titleAr: اقفل بوابة أو شركة شحن على متجر (فريق المنصة)
titleEn: Deactivate a provider for one store (platform staff)

operatorReason.text: provider verification and abuse (fraud): platform staff turn a provider off for one store

ar: ازاي ارجّع البوابة بعد ما اتقفلت؟
en: Why was my provider turned off for my store?
How do I get my gateway back after it was turned off?

steps: Super admin opens Activation requests, picks the row and deactivates with a note the merchant sees
edgeCases: Deactivating switches the gateway or carrier off, closes the activated request and emails the merchant the note
Activate (kept as the override) still needs the store's own passing test: no force past the money gate
Both leave a row in the append-only activation ledger
Deactivate also blocks the store from turning that provider on again until a super admin unblocks it
